system.description:
Prerequisites: Advanced Auspex, Basic Obfuscate, Advanced Vicissitude. The aura is a byproduct of the body; change the body, and you change the soul. By fleshcrafting certain locations on the body — chakras, joints, erogenous zones — a Tzimisce with this power can "paint" whatever aura she chooses, concealing mood, the stain of diablerie, or even the Curse of Caine from perceptive eyes.

System: After spending three Willpower points, the player rolls Perception + Empathy (difficulty equal to the subject's Willpower; stronger personalities resist alteration more easily). The number of successes indicates how completely the aura can be changed: one success alters shades (pale or bright); two alter the main color; three alter apparent psychological state (frenzied, psychotic, etc.); four can conceal or falsify diablerie and magic use; five can conceal or falsify the subject's natural condition (vampire, shapeshifter, ghost, etc.). The deception lasts one night per success, during which the aura doesn't change to reflect new conditions in its owner. These are changes only to the aura, not the subject herself, though the subject may feel token emotions to match her new colors at the Storyteller's discretion. Costs 20 experience points to learn.

MET System: Spend a Willpower Trait to alter the color of your own aura; each Willpower Trait spent grants more control over the conditions of your aura, from changing one aspect with a single Trait up to five different facets with five Traits. Changes made to your aura are undetectable in Auspex Challenges, and the deception lasts for a night. You may also manipulate the aura of another Kindred or kine by spending a Willpower Trait and winning a Static Willpower Challenge against them. Costs 6 Experience Traits to learn.
system.source: Clanbook: Tzimisce, Chapter Two: Ego and Evolution
